x-k-k9-08.title: Hojiiwwan kam har'a jalqabuu danda'u?
x-k-k9-08.goal: Hojiiwwan yaadannoo wal-gahii keessa jiran kam guutuu ta'e murteessi, achiis garee gaaffii sirrii waa'ee kan hin guutamne gaafadhu.
x-k-k9-08.material: Yaadannoon wal-gahii 10월 20일 booda wal-gahii garee torbanii barreeffame (참석: 팀장, 이 과장, 박 대리, 최 사원). Hojiiwwan shan galmaa'an; filannoo tarkaanfii 1 ta'anii mul'atu.
x-k-k9-08.thinking.1: Abbaa qabeenyaa ykn guyyaa hafe argachuu
x-k-k9-08.thinking.2: Gaaffii itti fufiinsaa xiyyeeffannaa qabu gaafachuu
x-k-k9-08.prereq.0: Yaadannoo wal-gahii Koreaa gabaabaa dubbisuu danda'a
x-k-k9-08.prereq.1: 담당 (nama itti gaafatamummaa qabu) fi 기한 (guyyaa dhumaa) beeka
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.prompt: Hojiiwwan kam guutuu dha, kanaaf nama maqaan kaa'ame eenyu, maal, yoom gaafachuu osoo hin barbaachisiin karoorfachuu fi hojjechuu danda'a? Hundumaa filadhu.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.hint.0: Hoji tokkoon tokkoon nama hojjetu ta'ee dubbisi. Gaaffii jalqabaa ati gaafattu barreessi.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.hint.1: Hojiiwwan shanan wal bira qabi: kam nama hojjetuuf gaaffii hin dhiisu?
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.r.a: Kana akka qophaa'etti lakkaa'uun 'wal-gahii itti aanu dura' ifa hin taane akka guyyaa fudhatamu agarsiisa.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.r.b: Nama, hojii fi yeroo walitti arguun qaamolee hojii sadan hundumaa ilaaluu kee agarsiisa.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.r.c: Kana akka qophaa'etti lakkaa'uun abbaa qabeenyaa fi guyyaan dhabame hubatamuu dhabuu agarsiisa.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.r.d: Nama, hojii fi guyyaa hima tokko keessatti ilaaluun tokkoon tokkoon isaa karaa tokkoon akka qorattu agarsiisa.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.r.e: Nama maqaa qabu qofti gahaa miti; guyyaan xumuraa dhabame fi bal'ina ifa hin taane kan qophaa'uu irraa isa to'atu.
x-k-k9-08.s.s1.explain: Hojiiwwan nama maqaa qabu, hojii ifa fi guyyaa xumuraa qaban battalumatti karoorfamee jalqabamuu danda'u: ilaalcha 이 과장 (ganama 21 dura) fi qophii gaaffilee 박 대리 (22 dura). Hojiin iddoo abbaa qabeenyaa fi guyyaa hin qabu, hojiin baajeetaa abbaa qabeenyaa hin qabu, 'wal-gahii itti aanu dura' qofa (guyyaa miti), hojiin tarreeffama maamilaa abbaa qabeenyaa qaba garuu guyyaa xumuraa hin qabu.
x-k-k9-08.s.s2.prompt: Hojii hin guutamne TOKKO filadhu, garuu garee dhaaf gaaffii gabaabaa Afaan Koreaatiin odeeffannoo hafe gaafadhu. Ulfina qabeessi ta'i, maqaa hojii sanaa kaa'i.
x-k-k9-08.s.s2.hint.0: Hojii filatte maqaa kaa'i, wanta hojii sun ammas dhabe qofa gaafadhu.
x-k-k9-08.s.s2.hint.1: Gaaffiin ulfina qabeessi -ㄹ까요? ykn -는지 여쭤봐도 될까요? tiin xumuramuu danda'a.
x-k-k9-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Gaaffiin koo wanta hafe qofa gaafataa?
x-k-k9-08.s.s2.modelNote.1: Dhugaa lama waa'ee hojii baajeetaa hafe gaafata.
x-k-k9-08.s.s2.modelNote.5: Hojiin kun duraanuu abbaa qabeenyaa qaba, kanaaf guyyaa qofa gaafatama.

x-k-k9-01.title: Gaaffii dukkanaa'aa hogganaa garee irraa
x-k-k9-01.topic: Email iddoo hojii: gaaffii nama olaanaa irraa (odeeffannoo barbaachisaa filachuu)
x-k-k9-01.goal: Odeeffannoon dhugumatti hanqate kamtu gaaffii nama olaanaa gabaabaa haala guddaa qabu keessaa akka ta'e murteessi, fi deebii ulfinaa isaanii kanaaf gaafadhu.
x-k-k9-01.material:
Ati 박 사원, hojjetaa xiqqaa. 6:40 p.m. irratti 팀장 kee (hogganaa garee) ergaa kana siif erga:

"박 사원님, 내일 오전 회의에서 쓸 자료 좀 정리해 주세요. 지난번처럼 부탁해요."

Wanta ati beektu:
- Ji'a darbe 팀장 tiif meeshaa gosa lama hojjette: 월간 실적 요약 (cuunfaa bu'aa ji'aa) fi 신제품 일정표 (sagantaa oomisha haaraa). Lamaanuu bifa wal-fakkaataatiin hojjetame.
- Ergaan walga'iin yoom akka jalqabu hin jedhu.
- Osoo hin jalqabin ergaa deebii TOKKO qofa ergi.
